tokens.name: ss-navy
tokens.usage: Headings, titles, card titles, strong 1-2px rules, table header rules and dark bands. 13:1 on ss-white, 11.5:1 on ss-mist.

tokens.name: ss-blue
tokens.usage: Links, text buttons and coloured bands that carry text (ss-white text on it, 5.5:1). 5.5:1 on ss-white, 4.8:1 on ss-mist.

tokens.name: ss-cyan
tokens.usage: Rules, bullets, focus outlines, highlights, callout edges and text 24px or larger only (3.5:1 on ss-white). Never a fill behind small text.

tokens.name: ss-light-cyan
tokens.usage: Small text or active states on ss-navy (6.8:1). Not for use on light grounds.

tokens.name: ss-ink
tokens.usage: Body text on ss-white, ss-mist and ss-paper; text on ss-action buttons (13:1).

tokens.name: ss-grey
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, labels, metadata. 6:1 on ss-white, 5.2:1 on ss-mist, 5.3:1 on ss-paper.

tokens.name: ss-midgrey
tokens.usage: Decorative, non-text only: hairlines, shape fills, diagram areas. Never for text or for icons and borders that carry meaning; use ss-grey for those.

tokens.name: ss-mist
tokens.usage: Light Gray. Panels, subtle backgrounds, table row hover, callout ground. Safe ground for the logo.

tokens.name: ss-paper
tokens.usage: Notes and quiet callout panels.

tokens.name: ss-white
tokens.usage: Page background; text on ss-navy and ss-blue.

tokens.name: ss-on-navy-body
tokens.usage: Body text on ss-navy bands (white at about 86% over navy), 10:1. Headings on navy stay ss-white.

tokens.name: ss-action
tokens.usage: Green action colour: buttons and calls to action only. Text on it is ss-action-ink, edge ss-action-edge.

tokens.name: ss-action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of ss-action buttons (ss-ink text 11.6:1).

tokens.name: ss-action-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ss-action and ss-action-hover. Never white.

tokens.name: ss-action-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border around action buttons.

tokens.name: ss-rule
tokens.usage: Neutral rules, dividers and table cell lines (ss-navy at 18%).

tokens.name: ss-focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 2px offset, on light grounds (3.5:1 on ss-white). On ss-navy use ss-white.

tokens.name: ss-error-edge
tokens.usage: Error border on form fields (6:1 on ss-white).

tokens.name: ss-error-ink
tokens.usage: Error message text on ss-white (8.2:1).

tokens.name: ss-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning panel ground.

tokens.name: ss-warning-edge
tokens.usage: Warning panel edge (decorative; message carries the meaning in ss-warning-ink).

tokens.name: ss-warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text on ss-warning-bg (8.7:1).

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Hero titles. Fluid: clamp(2.125rem, 1.35rem + 2.9vw, 3.5rem), 34 to 56px. ss-navy, text-wrap: balance, sentence case.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: GRC facade panels for coastal towers
styles.usage: Page titles. Fluid: clamp(1.875rem, 1.42rem + 1.75vw, 2.75rem), 30 to 44px. ss-navy, balance.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings. Fluid: clamp(1.5625rem, 1.42rem + 0.58vw, 2rem), 25 to 32px. ss-navy. Articles: 32px above, 8px below.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections. Fluid: clamp(1.25rem, 1.17rem + 0.33vw, 1.5rem), 20 to 24px. ss-navy. Articles: 24px above, 12px below.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: H4 and card titles. Fluid: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.03rem + 0.16vw, 1.1875rem), 17 to 19px. ss-navy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, table headers, form labels, footer headings, spec labels. Fluid 12 to 13px. Always uppercase, 0.1-0.12em.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: ShapeShift Technologies designs and manufactures FRP, GRC and GRG facade panels.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs. Fluid 17 to 19px; line height 1.68 in articles. ss-ink.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each panel is moulded to the architect's geometry, then finished and inspected before it leaves the factory.
styles.usage: Body copy, lists, table cells in prose. Fluid: clamp(1rem, 0.98rem + 0.1vw, 1.0625rem), 16 to 17px. ss-ink. 500/600 for emphasis.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, metadata, table cells, footer text. Fluid 14 to 15px. ss-grey for secondary text; tabular numerals where figures align.

tokens.name: ss-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps; joint between icon and text.

tokens.name: ss-2
tokens.usage: Space below article H2, between consecutive text blocks and list items; callout vertical padding.

tokens.name: ss-3
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing in articles; space below H3; form field groups; table cell vertical padding; callout side padding.

tokens.name: ss-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: ss-5
tokens.usage: Space above article H3; standard section padding at 1024px and below.

tokens.name: ss-6
tokens.usage: Space above article H2; tight sections; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: ss-7
tokens.usage: Standard section padding.

tokens.name: ss-8
tokens.usage: Hero section padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: ss-radius
tokens.usage: Every corner: buttons, inputs, cards, panels.

tokens.name: ss-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and chips only.

tokens.name: ss-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target.

tokens.name: ss-input
tokens.usage: Input and mobile menu row height.
